subject: Recap: expansion call — volume sensitivity & target $/1M tokens
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnston <claire@logiware.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: expansion call — volume sensitivity & target $/1M tokens

Claire — thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and next steps so we have alignment going into procurement: 

Key points we discussed:
- LogiWare current committed baseline: ~750M tokens/month (Q4 2026). Expected ramp to ~1.8B tokens/month by end of Q2 2027 with the new routing and embedding workloads.
- Current renewal pricing: $85 / 1M tokens (existing plan). Target blended economics discussed: $50–65 / 1M tokens depending on committed step-ups and route mix.
- Route mix impact: generation-heavy routes (chat) are higher cost per token vs embedding-dominant routes. We can route embedding flows to a quantized variant to improve unit economics.

Proposed commercial construct (high-level):
- Commit bands: 0–1B, 1B–3B, 3B+ tokens/month; step-up discounts at each band.
- Example blended model (illustrative): up to 1B @ $70/1M; next 1–3B @ $48/1M → blended for 1.8B ≈ $54/1M.
- Add-on: route-level overrides for embeddings (savings of ~25–30% on embedding tokens when using q4 quantized route).

Attachments sent with this note:
- LogiWare_pricing-proposal-v2.pdf (proposal and sample SOW)
- token-econ-sensitivity.xlsx (breakdown of blended calc and sensitivity to mix/volumes)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether the 1.8B is a conservative calendar Q2 peak or a steady-state monthly expectation? (need to size Dedicated / reserved capacity).
2) Please introduce Evan (procurement) to the thread so we can align on PO/PO terms and billing cadence.
3) If acceptable, we'll prepare a formal MSA redline and a canary capacity plan for Jan–Mar 2027.

If you're ok with the example blended shown above, we'll lock the math into the proposal and push to procurement.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
nkhil@redwood.com

From: Claire Johnston <claire@logiware.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan.torres@logiware.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: expansion call — volume sensitivity & target $/1M tokens

Nikhil — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- The 1.8B is our planning assumption for steady-state by end of Q2 (not just a peak). We expect a stepped ramp: 750M → ~1.2B (Q1) → ~1.8B (Q2).
- Two routing notes: (1) we do expect significant embedding volume from search (roughly 40% of tokens in Q2), and (2) prefix caching will reduce repeat-generation token exposure on several product flows; can you confirm how caching behaviors were modeled in your sensitivity sheet?

Procurement: looping in Evan Torres (cc) — Evan, happy to hand over the commercial, timeline target is to have pricing and MSA agreed by 12/20 so Finance can slot the budget for Jan.

Claire Johnston
Head of Product, LogiWare
claire@logiware.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnston <claire@logiware.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 10:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: expansion call — volume sensitivity & target $/1M tokens

Thanks Claire — quick follow-up with the modeled economics and one explicit worked example so procurement has a clear starting point. See excerpt below; full calc in token-econ-sensitivity.xlsx (attached in original email).

Worked example (1.8B steady-state):
- Band pricing (for illustration):
  • 0–1,000M tokens/month: $70 / 1M
  • 1,000M–3,000M tokens/month: $48 / 1M
  • >3,000M: $40 / 1M (corporate commitment tier)

- If LogiWare consumes 1,800M tokens/month with the mix we discussed (60% generation, 40% embeddings with embeddings routed to quantized variant):
  • First 1,000M @ $70 => $70,000
  • Next 800M @ $48 => $38,400
  • Total monthly token charge: $108,400 => effective blended = $108,400 / 1,800 ≈ $60.22 / 1M tokens

Notes on caching & routes:
- Caching assumptions: we applied a conservative 12% effective token reduction from prefix/KV caching across generative routes in the workbook; if LogiWare can confirm more (e.g., 20–25%) that would materially lower the blended $/1M.
- Embeddings route: quoted as $35 / 1M (quantized route) in the spreadsheet which is reflected in the blended calc above.

Suggested next steps for commercial granularity:
1) LogiWare confirms steady-state monthly target (confirming Claire's 1.8B helps us finalize Dedicated capacity sizing).
2) We propose a 12/15 internal RFC for MSA + PO terms; final sign by 12/20 to meet your finance window.
3) If accepted, Redwood will provision a canary pool and reserve a 20% burst buffer for Q1.

I'll update the proposal PDF with the worked example and re-upload.

—Aditya
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Aditya / Nikhil — thanks for the worked example, that helps a lot. Confirmations from our side: 

- We confirm the steady-state target of ~1.8B tokens/month by end of Q2 2027.
- Caching: our engineering team estimates ~18% effective savings from prefix caching on gen flows (we'll validate with logs and send a short report).
- Procurement timeline: Evan will lead. We aim to have MSA + PO issued by 12/20. Evan, attaching a PO template and the procurement contact list as a starter.

On price: the worked example blended to ~$60.22 / 1M is close to our internal target. After internal review we can accept a target blended of $55–$58 / 1M if you can: (a) lock in the 1.8B committed band and (b) include the embeddings quantized route at the rates referenced.

I'll ask Evan to confirm exact PO terms (payment net-30 vs 45) and loop him into the DocuSign when the redline is ready.

Thanks —
Claire Johnston
Head of Product, LogiWare
claire@logiware.com
